result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers show the same light and dark episode lists side by side, with a warm near-black background, slightly lighter cards with subtle borders, a lighter coral accent on the play buttons, and readable muted text. B's accent looks a little more saturated. Neither answer clearly beats the other. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers show the same five episodes in light and dark panels side by side. Both dark themes use a warm near-black background, slightly lighter cards with subtle borders, a lighter coral accent with dark play icons, and readable muted text.
